snippet.title: The Killing Stone - Launch Date Trailer 4K
snippet.description:
The Killing Stone is an all new deckbuilding card battler with a 17th century occult horror narrative. Each card battle forms part of a bargaining ritual where you mediate the fate of members of a cursed family. Use your wits to beat the Devil at his own game. Starring Emma Gregory and Liam O'Brien in a story written and performed twice: in 17th century period English prose and again in modern English. Demo available on Steam. Wishlist it today!
Learn more at https://www.thekillingstone.com/
